clips.title: The story
paras: Grenka's Claw is a physical trophy taken from the formidable harpy Grenka Bloodscreech in the depths of Roguefeather Den. Presented to Dorn Plainstalker at the Weathered Nook, it serves as undeniable proof that an aspiring adventurer has endured a grueling physical trial in the canyon heights.

Within the winding caverns of Roguefeather Den, west of Freewind Post, harpies cache food and violently defend their territory against outsiders. To test the physical resilience of young champions, Dorn Plainstalker tasks them with invading the deep roosts and destroying the flock's food reserves. Such brazen provocation inevitably draws the fury of Grenka Bloodscreech. Severing and returning her wicked talon proves that a warrior can withstand wave after wave of enraged harpies and survive the vicious onslaught of their matriarch.
